e AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT e.* FROM trading_events e WHERE e.account_id IN(43002148,46130058,47790949,49236051) AND e.received_at<'2026-11-12T12:28Z' AND (e.entry_key IN(SELECT entry_key FROM o) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM p WHERE p.account_id=e.account_id AND p.position_id=e.position_id))),
